title: sha2 0.10 → 0.11 dependency bump in osf
summary: A dependency-only change: the `osf` crate moves from `sha2` 0.10 to 0.11, which drags the whole RustCrypto digest stack forward. `digest` 0.11 replaces `generic-array` with `hybrid-array` and pulls in `const-oid`, `block-buffer` and `crypto-common` bump to their 0.12/0.2 lines, and `cpufeatures` moves to 0.3. No application code changes; the only source edit is the version constraint in `crates/osf/Cargo.toml`, with `Cargo.lock` re-resolved to match.

nodes.label: osf
nodes.subtitle: crates/osf
nodes.summary: The workspace crate that depends on sha2. Its manifest constraint moved from 0.10 to 0.11; no Rust source in the crate changed.

nodes.label: Cargo.lock
nodes.subtitle: resolved dependency graph
nodes.summary: The lockfile re-resolved against the new constraint: sha2, digest, block-buffer, crypto-common and cpufeatures all moved, generic-array was dropped and hybrid-array plus const-oid were added.

nodes.label: sha2
nodes.summary: The SHA-2 implementation the osf crate calls. The 0.11 release is built on digest 0.11 and therefore on hybrid-array rather than generic-array.

nodes.label: digest
nodes.summary: The hashing trait layer. 0.11 drops generic-array, adds const-oid, and re-points block-buffer and crypto-common at their new major lines.

nodes.label: block-buffer
nodes.summary: Block buffering used by the digest implementations. Its dependency on generic-array is replaced by hybrid-array.

nodes.label: crypto-common
nodes.summary: Shared crypto traits. It loses typenum and generic-array and now depends only on hybrid-array.

nodes.label: cpufeatures
nodes.summary: CPU feature detection used by sha2 to select accelerated backends. Bumped to the 0.3 line; still depends on libc.

nodes.label: const-oid
nodes.subtitle: 0.10.2 (new)
nodes.summary: Newly pulled in by digest 0.11. It has no dependencies of its own.

nodes.label: hybrid-array
nodes.subtitle: 0.4.15 (new)
nodes.summary: The replacement for generic-array as the fixed-size array abstraction under digest, block-buffer and crypto-common. Depends only on typenum.

nodes.label: generic-array
nodes.subtitle: 0.14.7 (dropped)
nodes.summary: No longer present in the resolved graph: nothing in the new digest stack depends on it.

nodes.label: typenum
nodes.subtitle: type-level numbers
nodes.summary: Still present, but now reached through hybrid-array instead of generic-array.
